messages:
ana (Design): dropping a short thread on the keys page UX. two things we need quick input on: 1) use of a transient toast after rotate vs staying in modal, 2) an extra inline confirmation when creating Admin-scoped keys. quick takes?

tom (Eng): toast is easiest to implement. but toasts disappear and SR users can miss the new secret. if we go toast, we should also open a modal drawer showing the new secret so screen readers get the content.

sam (A11y): prefer staying in-modal until user dismisses. toasts are problematic for SRs unless mirrored in a persistent region. If toast used: add aria-live=\"polite\" for non-critical and assertive for revoke. Also ensure copy is explicit: avoid words like \"irreversible\" alone.

rachel (PM): product would like minimal friction. users often rotate keys and then immediately copy. staying in-modal seems higher signal and no real downside. For Admin creation, could we have a lightweight inline confirmation (checkbox: \"I understand admin keys can manage apps\") instead of another modal?

ana (Design): sketching flow: keep modal open after rotate, auto-select secret input and show a small banner: \"This is the only time you'll see this secret.\" Add a separate toast: \"Key rotated\" that appears for visual users and focuses the persistent secret area for screen readers. For Admin role: inline yellow banner under dropdown with small checkbox to confirm if role=Admin. microcopy: \"Admin tokens can create and rotate keys and manage apps.\"

tom (Eng): checkbox is fine. implementation note: make sure the banner is aria-describedby of the dropdown so it's read on change. selecting and copying the field can be done with focus + execCommand copy fallback.

sam (A11y): checklist for PR: 1) modal stays open and secret region has aria-live=\"assertive\" + aria-atomic; 2) toast is decorative only for SRs (aria-hidden=true); 3) admin banner is programmatically linked and includes non-color cues; 4) icon contrast meets 4.5:1.

ci-bot: pipeline green for branch feature/keys-ux-1834 (build 2027-01-12T08:04Z).

rachel (PM): great. ana please push updated mocks and i'll schedule a 10-min pairing to validate focus order after the PR lands.

ana (Design): will do, thanks team :thumbsup:
